description: Football (soccer) matches with TipMaster expert predictions, filtered by team, competition (e.g. "Bundesliga", "Premier League", "LaLiga"), mode, status and kickoff window: upcoming (locked), live and finished (played) matches of the last 10 days. Each line has teams, kickoff, status, result, the most likely score and the home/draw/away call of the Top 20%, Top 25% and All players groups.

mode.description: national (exact scores, 15 countries) or classic (home/draw/away, 25 matches a week); omit for both.

status.description: open, locked (final predictions, not played yet), played or cancelled; omit for all.
